Type: galvanized steel shelving unit
Use: storing boxes, tools, plants and supplies; garage, balcony, utility room, storage room

Materials: galvanized steel frame and shelves

Goes with: concrete, plywood, green plants, black accents; industrial lofts, utility rooms and balconies
